title: Character Frequency Counter
statement:
Given a string S of lowercase English letters, print the frequency of each letter that appears in S.

Print each character and its count on a separate line, in alphabetical order. Only print letters that appear at least once.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 10^5
S contains only lowercase English letters.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string S.
outputFormat: For each distinct letter in S (in alphabetical order), print a line: "c f" where c is the character and f is its frequency.

examples.explanation: a appears 5 times, b appears 2 times, c once, d once, r 2 times.
